name: scene-stats
js: (()=>{const A=__CITY_APP,s=A.scene;let o=0,m=0,auto=0,vis=0,inst=0;s.traverse(x=>{o++;if(x.matrixAutoUpdate)auto++;if(x.isMesh||x.isLine||x.isPoints){m++;if(x.visible)vis++;if(x.isInstancedMesh)inst++;}});console.log('[stats] objects '+o+' meshes '+m+' visibleFlag '+vis+' instanced '+inst+' autoUpdate '+auto);const top=s.children.map(c=>{let n=0,a=0;c.traverse(x=>{n++;if(x.matrixAutoUpdate)a++});return [c.name||c.type,n,a]}).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,25);console.log('[stats] top '+top.map(t=>t.join(':')).join(' '));const r=A.renderer;const orig=r.render.bind(r);let log=[];r.render=function(sc,cam){const t=performance.now();const res=orig(sc,cam);log.push((sc.name||sc.type)+'/'+(cam.name||cam.type)+' calls '+r.info.render.calls+' tris '+r.info.render.triangles);return res};setTimeout(()=>{r.render=orig;console.log('[stats] renders/frame sample: '+log.slice(-12).join(' ; '))},1000)})()
